definitions.explanation: A four-character idiom describing someone who has no sense of shame, who acts boldly despite doing things that should cause embarrassment.

examples.japanese: {厚顔無恥|こうがんむち}な{態度|たいど}に{呆|あき}れた。
examples.english: I was amazed by such shameless behavior.

examples.japanese: {厚顔無恥|こうがんむち}にも{平気|へいき}で{嘘|うそ}をつく。
examples.english: He shamelessly tells lies without a care.

examples.japanese: あの{政治家|せいじか}は{厚顔無恥|こうがんむち}だ。

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご})

LITERAL MEANING: {厚顔|こうがん} (thick face/skin) + {無恥|むち} (no shame) = Having a thick skin and no shame.

USAGE PATTERNS:
・{厚顔無恥|こうがんむち}な＋noun (shameless ~)
・{厚顔無恥|こうがんむち}にも (shamelessly)
・{厚顔無恥|こうがんむち}な{人|ひと} (a shameless person)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{厚顔無恥|こうがんむち}な{態度|たいど} (shameless attitude)
・{厚顔無恥|こうがんむち}な{行為|こうい} (brazen act)
・{厚顔無恥|こうがんむち}にも{平気|へいき}で (shamelessly and without hesitation)

NUANCE: Strongly negative, used to criticize someone who should feel ashamed but doesn't.

ENGLISH EQUIVALENTS:
・Shameless
・Brazen
・Thick-skinned
・Having no shame

RELATED TERMS:
・{図々|ずうずう}しい - shameless, brazen (colloquial)
・{恥知|はじし}らず - shameless person
・{厚|あつ}かましい - impudent, shameless
・{傍若無人|ぼうじゃくぶじん} - arrogant, acting as if no one exists
